verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents a compliance dashboard that shows per-state requirements and upcoming deadlines and lets founders "take any necessary actions" (docs-7, docs-28). It also bundles a compliance subscription into Firstbase One (docs-4), which implies deadline tracking and some filing action. However, no evidence explicitly says the platform files annual reports or franchise tax, and the community mention of annual Wyoming returns does not clearly say Firstbase filed them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of annual report filing, explicit franchise tax filing/payment, on-time filing guarantees or reminders detail, independent hands-on corroboration.
